Using A = M/10 with M = [[-3,1,-10],[2,9,4],[-9,-6,9]], the characteristic polynomial is

det(μI - M) = μ^3 - 15μ^2 - 41μ + 1059.

This gives one real eigenvalue μ ≈ -7.77 and a complex pair with modulus ≈ 11.66. Thus the eigenvalues of A are μ/10, so the spectral radius is ≈ 1.166 > 1.
